# Committee Introduction

We are Minnetonka residents working together to support a 6% cap on annual City of Minnetonka property tax levy increases. 
We welcome residents who want to learn more, volunteer, or help with the initiative.

# Committee Members

## Kelly Chermack - President

## Tom Stockert - Secretary / Treasurer

Tom Stockert moved to Minnetonka in 2013 and is a retired Chief Financial Officer and active local volunteer. 
He helped found a Minnetonka habitat restoration nonprofit, where he serves on the board and volunteers. 
He also volunteers with a local animal rescue and pursues other volunteer activities. 
Keeping Minnetonka a great, affordable place to live is a passion for Tom.

## Robert (Bob) Falk

Bob Falk has been a resident of Minnetonka for 37 years, retired business owner, former coach of youth sports.
He has had many activities related to community service.
He would like to continue to live in Minnetonka.

## Kristin Gaarder

Kristin Gaarder is a resident of Minnetonka, an active volunteer and board member with several local non-profit organizations focused on youth homelessness and outdoor recreation. 
She is committed to ensuring Minnetonka is an affordable vibrant community for all current and future residents.

## Tracy Ericksen

Tracy Ericksen has lived in Minnetonka since 2021 and is the founder of Kiwi Group, a Salesforce consulting business. 
She values the community and natural surroundings that make Minnetonka a special place to call home. 
She joined the committee to support responsible city spending and help ensure residents can afford to stay in the community they love.
